protocol: Fixed before retrieval implementation. Development examples D are excluded from evaluation E. Within the closed evaluation set only listed positives are relevant; remaining cross-document pairs are negatives by the independently assigned task/person scenarios. Ranking is not semantic confirmation. Statements alone are embedded, without gold labels or task ids. Report recall/precision at 1 and 5, false positives and missed pairs. No tuning on E.
